input: I ordered headphones from ShopKart on 12 Oct 2026 for Rs 2,499. Order ID SK12345. It never arrived, promised by 18 Oct. I emailed twice and they ignored me.

next_steps.step: Contact the seller/platform grievance or customer-support channel and request a written resolution.
If unresolved, consider registering a pre-litigation consumer grievance with the National Consumer Helpline (1915 or consumerhelpline.gov.in).
If still unresolved, check whether filing with the appropriate Consumer Commission through e-Jagriti is suitable; get individual legal advice before formal filing.

output.complaint_draft:
Subject: Complaint - Non-delivery of order (Order SK12345)

To: ShopKart Customer Support / Grievance Team

I am writing about my purchase of headphones on 12 Oct 2026, order number SK12345, for Rs 2,499. The order has not been delivered.

Please review my order, explain what has happened, and provide an appropriate resolution, including a refund where applicable. Please acknowledge this complaint and respond in writing. I can provide relevant invoices, payment records and correspondence.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your preferred contact details]
output.human_escalation: If there is a formal legal notice, large loss, disputed facts, or court filing, seek an independent qualified lawyer.
